name: patchline
description: Patchline: AI vulnerability scanning with human-approved fixes. 1 frontend + 3 backends (auth, main — Node/Express; ai-storage — Python/FastAPI), wired end-to-end with JWT, Redis, Supabase, MongoDB, and Azure Blob.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,main,ai,web -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix services/auth_services run dev" "npm --prefix services/main_services run dev" "npm run dev:ai" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/auth_services && npm install --prefix services/main_services && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run install:ai
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/auth_services test && npm --prefix services/main_services test && npm run test:ai
scripts.lint: npm --prefix services/auth_services run lint && npm --prefix services/main_services run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
